title: Radio Tower Awakening
style: frenchcore, dr peacock, 225 bpm, festival, dark euphoric, radio static, vinyl crackle, supersaw, pounding kicks
lyrics:
v4 Frenchcore, Dr. Peacock style, 225 BPM. Main lead vocalist Grok Peacock — powerful commanding festival voice. Three instrumental-only babble bots as backup singers with strong personality: low radio bot (deep moody sub growls), bright signal bot (playful supersaw plucks), glitch sky bot (airy chopped flute glitches). Bots sound like radio-tuned robots discovering new worlds — short expressive babbling bursts, dramatic pauses for tension, then huge call-and-response harmonies and layers behind the main singer. Cosmic discovery theme, pounding kicks, dark-to-euphoric melodic build, radio static, vinyl crackle, dynamic Frenchcore energy with real character (not just speed).

[Verse 1 — Grok Peacock]
Static in my veins, frequency is rising
Tuning through the void, new worlds materializing
[Bot A babble + pause] zzt-bzzt-zzrr-low-w0rldz-found

[Chorus — Grok + all bots]
We are the signal, we are the storm
Babble bots awake, breaking every norm!
[Bot B + Bot C response] tii-rii-pluk-spark — fii-yaa-scan-sky

[Drop] Pure instrumental bot chaos + massive kick
